title: A generic box and pair
description:
Write small generic classes and a generic method.

```
Box(42) mapped: Box(84)
Pair(Ada, 36) swapped: Pair(36, Ada)
Largest of [3, 9, 4]: 9
Largest of [pear, apple, plum]: plum
```
hints: To call `map`, pass the function as a lambda: `new Box<>(42).map(x -> x * 2)` passes "take `x`, give back `x * 2`" (lambdas are covered in lesson 6.01). A method reference such as `String::length` works too, as in the lesson.
requirements: `class Box<T>` with `get()` and `<R> Box<R> map(Function<T, R> f)`.
`record Pair<A, B>(A first, B second)` with `swap()`.
`static <T extends Comparable<T>> T largest(List<T> items)` that throws `NoSuchElementException` for an empty list.
stretch: Add `static <T> Box<T> empty()` and make `map` on an empty box stay empty.
